summary: Independent review accepted the manager adapter: exact Go error frames are surfaced, source this binding and layered idempotence hold, all eight session-manager methods are wrapped, ordinary fake values survive, and actual host dispatch preserves Go detail in the keyed-host cause chain. Focused Node tests passed 19/19 and a raw WASM host probe passed; encodeHTTP/decodeHTTP remain separately wrapped by demo.mjs and their failing browser path was not run.
